chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Haytham, from ʿUbaydah, from Ibrāhīm, who said:
The value of the slave is due from the master; nothing more than that is upon him.

key_terms.أَكْثَرُ: more; any amount beyond the assessed value
key_terms.الْمَوْلَى: the master, the legally responsible owner in this context
key_terms.ذَلِكَ: that; referring to the slave’s value already mentioned
key_terms.قِيمَةُ: the monetary value or assessed price
key_terms.لَيْسَ: is not; negates any additional liability

ai.seo_question: What is the master liable to pay regarding a slave in this legal ruling?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning liability involving a slave, specifying that the master is responsible only for the slave’s monetary value. It indicates a limit to financial responsibility in this judicial context.
